opener: Asks the others whether anyone has the flat keys and suggests Saturday for clearing the wardrobe.

private_lines.Defne: You work as a freelance graphic designer from your home in Istanbul, so your hours are flexible and you often work late into the night. You live alone, and your days are mostly spent at your desk with some time out in the neighbourhood.
